message.content:
Conveyor belts of vulcanized rubber fall under heading 4010. Subheading 4010.19 covers other conveyor belts, and 4010.12 covers conveyor belts reinforced only with textile materials. Since this belt is reinforced only with polyester and nylon textile plies, 4010.12 applies.

The 4010.12 subheading has a single statistical suffix, 4010.12.0000, so the code is 4010.12.0000.

Heading 4010 covers conveyor or transmission belts of vulcanized rubber. Subheading 4010.11 covers belts reinforced with metal, 4010.12 covers belts reinforced with textile materials, and 4010.19 covers other belts. The HTSUS 4010.12 is "Of textile materials," with the 10-digit code 4010.12.0000.

{"hts_code": "4010.12.0000", "reason": "Conveyor belts of vulcanized rubber reinforced only with textile materials (polyester and nylon plies) are classified in heading 4010, subheading 4010.12."}
